completed_functional_audit.zero_independent_definition: For the repaired pole-regularized theta state Phi_t = (D^2 - 1/16)(t^{1/4} g_t) (or its squared pole-vanishing companion Phi_t^{(2)} = (D^2 - 1/16)^2(t^{1/4} g_t)) and the completed zero-independent explicit-formula linear functional W_comp(Psi) := W_pole(Psi) - sum_{p} H_p(Psi_p)(1) - H_infty(Psi_infty)(1), define the quadratic completed functional A_{Theta, C}^{cov}(t) := W_comp(J Phi_t) W_comp(L_heat J Phi_t) - W_comp(2 D J Phi_t)^2 (and its linear counterpart L_{Theta, C}^{cov}(t) := W_comp(L_heat J Phi_t), where 2 D = E_1D - 1/2 I acts on t^{1/4 - s/2} = t^{-z/2} by -z and L_heat = 4(D^2 - D) = 2D(2D - 2) acts by z(z + 2)).

background_terms_included.prime_power_terms: W_prim(J Phi_t) = -sum_{n>=2} Lambda(n) n^{-1/2} ((J Phi_t)(n) + (J Phi_t)(n^{-1})) = -sum_p H_p(Phi_{t,p})(1), where (J Phi_t)(u) = u^{1/2} Phi_t(u); because Phi_t(n^{-1}) = O(n^{-2}) as n -> infty, the reflected prime-power sum sum_{n>=2} Lambda(n) n^{-1} Phi_t(n^{-1}) = O(sum_{n>=2} Lambda(n) n^{-3}) converges absolutely.
background_terms_included.pole_terms_s_eq_0_and_1: W_pole(J Phi_t) = hat{(J Phi_t)}(-1/2) + hat{(J Phi_t)}(1/2) = M[Phi_t](0) + M[Phi_t](1). For Phi_t = (D^2 - 1/16) tilde{g}_t, the factor s(s-1)/4 cancels the simple pole of Gamma(s/2) ~ 2/s at s = 0 (leaving the finite value M[Phi_t](0) = -(1/4) t^{1/4}, which is subsequently annihilated by L_heat = 4(D^2 - D) when paired with (D - 1/4), or vanishes identically on the squared state Phi_t^{(2)} = (D^2 - 1/16)^2 tilde{g}_t where M[Phi_t^{(2)}](0) = M[Phi_t^{(2)}](1) = 0).
background_terms_included.trivial_zero_and_archimedean_gamma_terms: W_infty(J Phi_t) = -H_infty(Phi_{t,infty})(1) = (log(2*pi) + gamma_E) Phi_t(1) + int_{1/2}^infty (Phi_t(1/u) u - Phi_t(1))/|1 - u| du/(2u) + int_{-infty}^{1/2} Phi_t(1/|u|) |u| / |1 - u| du/(2|u|) (encodes pi^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2) and all trivial zeros s = -2m via Burnol Theorem D3)
background_terms_included.normalization_terms: Multiplicative half-density lift (J Phi_t)(u) = u^{1/2} Phi_t(u) in L^2(R_+^x, du/u), so that hat{(J Phi_t)}(z) = int_0^infty (J Phi_t)(u) u^{z} du/u = int_0^infty Phi_t(u) u^{s-1} du = M[Phi_t](s) with s = 1/2 + z
background_terms_included.regularization_at_origin_and_infinity: Because raw tilde{g}_t(0) = t^{1/4} != 0 and int_0^infty tilde{g}_t(u) du = (1/2) t^{-1/4} != 0 cause the reflected prime sum and the s = 0, 1 pole integrals to diverge (and the unshifted operator D(D - 1/2) gives D(D - 1/2) tilde{g}_t(0) = -(1/16) t^{1/4} != 0 with Mellin multiplier s^2/4 - 1/16), the weight-normalized theta state MUST be regularized by the shifted pole-annihilator P_reg(D) := D^2 - 1/16 = (D - 1/4)(D + 1/4), which multiplies M[tilde{g}_t](s) by (1/4 - s/2)^2 - 1/16 = s(s - 1)/4 = (z^2 - 1/4)/4 (matching completed xi(s) = 1/2 s(s - 1) pi^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2) zeta(s)).
background_terms_included.operator_domain_condition: Phi_t(u) := (D^2 - 1/16) tilde{g}_t(u) = t^{1/4} (pi^2 t^2 u^4 - (3/2) pi t u^2) e^{-pi t u^2} (and Phi_t^{(2)} := (D^2 - 1/16)^2 tilde{g}_t), satisfying Phi_t(0) = 0, Phi_t'(0) = 0, int_0^infty Phi_t(u) du = 0, super-polynomial Gaussian decay as u -> infty, and hat{(J Phi_t)}(z) = (1/8)(z^2 - 1/4) pi^{-(z+1/2)/2} Gamma((z+1/2)/2) t^{-z/2} holomorphic on Re(z) > -5/2.

complete_spectral_representation.linear_form_expansion: L_{Theta, C}^{cov}(t) = sum_rho m_rho z_rho (z_rho + 2) hat{(J Phi_t)}(z_rho) - W_pole(L_heat J Phi_t), where z_rho = rho - 1/2 = delta_rho + i*gamma_rho and hat{(J Phi_t)}(z_rho) = (1/4) t^{-z_rho/2} xi_factor(rho)
complete_spectral_representation.quadratic_variance_expansion: A_{Theta, C}^{cov}(t) = 1/2 sum_{rho, sigma} m_rho m_sigma hat{(J Phi_t^{(2)})}(z_rho) hat{(J Phi_t^{(2)})}(z_sigma) * [(z_rho - z_sigma)^2 + 2*(z_rho + z_sigma)]
complete_spectral_representation.convergence_justification: Rapid Gaussian/Gamma decay |hat{(J Phi_t)}(delta + i*gamma)| << |gamma|^{A} exp(-pi*|gamma|/4) gives absolute convergence of both the single and double sums over nontrivial zeros.
